title: refactor(ci): unify lint/test/release workflows, bump actions and deps hygiene
author: Maya Thompson
description: Motivation: our repo has accumulated dozens of per-repo and per-package GH workflows which are hard to maintain and cause long CI queues. This PR consolidates and splits responsibilities into three opinionated top-level workflows (lint, test, release) and performs dependency hygiene for GitHub Actions and key build deps. Goals: 1) reduce CI matrix duplication, 2) improve cache hit-rates and speed up common pushes, 3) make release automation more reliable and auditable, 4) bump several GH Actions to patched versions and remove deprecated actions. Changes are intentionally iterative and scope-limited to CI config and small helpers — no production code changes. Checklist: - [x] consolidate lint steps into .github/workflows/lint.yml - [x] split test into unit/integration matrix in .github/workflows/test.yml - [x] move release automation to .github/workflows/release.yml with clearer gating - [x] bump actions/checkout@v4, actions/setup-node@v4, actions/cache@v4 - [x] reduce node matrix to supported versions (18,20) and add explicit cache keys - [x] add composite action for repo-level cache key generation (.github/actions/cache-key) - [x] update docs/ci.md with new workflow triggers and troubleshooting notes - [x] run full CI and fix failing flakey test by increasing timeout in packages/perf-canary/test/harness.test.ts Notes: - Kept the legacy workflows as commented examples for two weeks to aid rollback. - Kept changes backwards-compatible with self-hosted runners. - This PR touches multiple top-level packages but only modifies CI and a small helper script that standardizes cache keys.
